mapper.sql: la.id, la.loan_apply_id, la.external_loan_apply_no, la.bill_no, la.apply_amt, la.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loan_application la WHERE la.user_id=#{userId} AND la.loan_apply_id=#{loanApplyId}
SELECT DISTINCT FROM loan_application la INNER JOIN repayment_plan_term rpt ON rpt.loan_application_id=la.id WHERE la.user_id=#{userId} AND rpt.term_status IN ('UNPAID','OVERDUE') ORDER BY la.id DESC
